units.source_text: 然而，阿笑看不见汉子的时候，

en.t: But when Axiao could no longer see the man,

units.source_text: 又小跑着折回来，躲在沿溪谷的村庄温泉后面，

en.t: she trotted back again and hid behind the village hot spring along the valley,

units.source_text: 心想，说不定自己相熟的汉子还会来洗温泉呢。

en.t: thinking that perhaps the man she knew might still come to bathe in the hot spring.
She waited there, curled up tightly.
